title: Accepted package versions are immutable
summary: Alchemy releases are versioned closures. Once a package version is accepted, fixes that change its source or dependency closure cut a new version; final releases do not silently rewrite accepted directories.
invariants: v0.5 was frozen from accepted RC2 product source without post-acceptance product-source changes.
Changing a package dependency manifest is a source/closure change and requires a new component version.
A future foundation uplift belongs to Core v0.6, not a retrofit of frozen Core v0.5.
Development labels (prebase/RC) and accepted release labels must remain distinct.

provenance.claim: Frozen v0.5 status, freeze rule and exact component closure.
v0.6 is a new line explicitly preserving v0.5.
